notes.title: Update 0.2 — Chapter 2 is here! 🦋
notes.notes:
🦋 Chapter 2 is here!

*Tales of Maana: Lucy* just got a big update with version 0.2!  
A new chapter, more languages, improvements… and an important note 👇

⚠️ Before you play...  
This version may reset your save data.  
There’s a high chance your progress will be lost — though in some cases, it might survive.

I’m really sorry about this 😞  
But this is the first and last time this will happen.  
I’d rather do it now, early in the story, than later when everything gets more complex.

To make it up to you, Chapter 1 has been improved with new choices and branching paths 💜

🆕 What’s new in 0.2:

🌍 5 new languages: Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Russian
🌹 Rose finally has a visual!
📝 New official title: Tales of Maana: Lucy
🏆 Achievements reworked: fewer, more meaningful
🛠️ UI and menus redesigned


Thank you so much for your patience, understanding and support.  
The journey is just beginning 🌙
